name: rannyaya-osen
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic transparent PNG virtual try-on sprite of the EXACT handmade diadem from reference 1. Identity: gold wire filigree low circlet, emerald green wire upper arcs, tiny mottled purple teal round beads, central faceted iridescent purple heart-shaped gemstone, central gold V points DOWN onto forehead. Preserve the two open leaf-shaped side lobes and the exact delicate, thin structure. No upward crown points. Correct the slight photographic skew to perfectly straight-on frontal view worn across upper forehead, both temples equally visible, central decoration exactly centered, horizontal level. Preserve original colors, bead distribution, wire weave and realistic proportions; do not redesign, thicken or embellish. Show only front and short temple portions that are visible on a front-facing head, remove rear headband hidden behind head. Entire jewelry fits inside a wide landscape canvas, centered, fills 85% width, with safe margin. Genuine transparent background and genuine alpha holes through ALL open wire spaces. NO mannequin, black fabric, skin, hair, face, portrait, shadow backdrop, floor, text, checkerboard or earrings. Fine sharp silver/gold wire edges, soft natural diffuse light with subtle metallic highlights. Single isolated diadem, not a collage.
